name: Skillet Stir-Fry
instructions: Have every ingredient chopped and ready before you turn on the heat -- stir-frying moves fast once it starts.
Cook protein first over high heat until just done, then remove it from the pan so it does not overcook.
Stir-fry vegetables in the same pan, hardest ones first, adding quicker-cooking ones later.
Return the protein, add sauce, and toss everything together for the last minute so it coats evenly.
